layer1_delta.note: Found this session as an incidental during a spot-check of edit-prefill for image/code/rich-content ad types (while re-verifying the video-edit fix did not regress the other three). Initially reported as a cosmetic gap (Alt Text input in templates/portal/ad-form.php ~line 661 had no value="..." attribute, so it always rendered empty on edit). The calling session traced the consequence further: save_ad_meta() only copies alt_text into _wbam_ad_data when the posted value is non-empty, so an edit submitted with the blank field silently drops the alt_text key from the blob -- and Image_Ad::render() (wb-ads-rotator-with-split-test/includes/Modules/AdTypes/class-image-ad.php:94) does `isset($data['alt_text']) ? $data['alt_text'] : get_the_title($ad_id)`, so the served alt attribute silently fell back to the ad's internal title for every screen reader, for every image ad edited after this release. The standalone _wbam_alt_text meta was unaffected (survived), so the value was not unrecoverable, but the customer-facing accessibility contract broke on every edit. Fixed in commit 16d1f73: added `value=""` to the Alt Text input, matching the target_url field three rows above it. Re-verified independently this pass via the real browser UI and a direct render check, not just code reading: created an image ad (#751) with alt text 'Spring sale banner' (flat _wbam_alt_text + _wbam_ad_data blob, matching what a genuine portal submission writes), confirmed via Image_Ad::render() the served markup carried alt="Spring sale banner" BEFORE editing (baseline); opened the ad for edit as fashionbrand, confirmed the Alt Text field showed 'Spring sale banner' on a fresh page load (screenshot taken); changed only the campaign end date (unrelated field, alt text untouched); clicked Update Ad (accepted, wbam_notice=ad-updated); confirmed afterward that _wbam_ad_data still carried the alt_text key ('Spring sale banner', not missing) and that Image_Ad::render() served alt="Spring sale banner" again -- not the ad's title 'Smoke Alt-Text Verify Ad'. The actual user-visible contract (served ) holds. Closed out as genuinely fixed.

The same template block (ad-form.php's edit-mode $ad_data builder) was touched twice now -- once for the video-fields fix, once for the alt-text fix. Re-verified the video edit flow was not disturbed by the second change: read the live video_url/click_url/skip_after block and confirmed it is byte-identical to what was verified last pass; created a fresh video ad (#752, flat meta + blob matching a genuine submission), opened it for edit, confirmed #wbam_video_url/#wbam_video_click_url/#wbam_video_skip_after still pre-fill correctly on a fresh page load, changed the title (unrelated to video), clicked Update Ad (accepted), and confirmed _wbam_ad_data/_wbam_video_url/_wbam_click_url/_wbam_skip_after all survived intact. No regression from stacking the two fixes in the same builder block.
